mapper.select:
SELECT TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, RULE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, ENABLED, CURRENT_VERSION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE WHERE 1 = 1
AND RULE_NAME LIKE '%' || #{searchDto.ruleName} || '%'
AND ENABLED = #{searchDto.enabled}
ORDER BY TRANSFORM_RULE_ID DESC
SELECT TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, RULE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, ENABLED, CURRENT_VERSION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE WHERE TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = #{transformRuleId}

SELECT V.TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, V.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, V.VERSION_NO, V.DATA_FORMAT, V.REPEAT_PATH, V.CREATED_AT FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION V INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE R ON V.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = R.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID AND V.VERSION_NO = R.CURRENT_VERSION WHERE R.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = #{transformRuleId}

SELECT TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, VERSION_NO, DATA_FORMAT, REPEAT_PATH, CREATED_AT FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION WHERE TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = #{transformRuleId} ORDER BY VERSION_NO DESC
SELECT TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, VERSION_NO, DATA_FORMAT, REPEAT_PATH, CREATED_AT FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION WHERE TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID = #{transformRuleVersionId}

SELECT TRANSFORM_FIELD_ID, TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, SOURCE_PATH, TARGET_NAME, DATA_TYPE, VALUE_FORMAT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE_FIELD WHERE TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID = #{transformRuleVersionId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, TRANSFORM_FIELD_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE ( RULE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, ENABLED, CURRENT_VERSION, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{ruleName}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{enabled}, #{currentVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION ( TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, VERSION_NO, DATA_FORMAT, REPEAT_PATH, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{transformRuleId}, #{versionNo}, #{dataFormat}, #{repeatPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE_FIELD ( TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID, SOURCE_PATH, TARGET_NAME, DATA_TYPE, VALUE_FORMAT, REQUIRED_YN, SORT_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{transformRuleVersionId}, #{sourcePath}, #{targetName}, #{dataType}, #{valueFormat, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requiredYn}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE SET RULE_NAME = #{ruleName}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ENABLED = #{enabled}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = #{transformRuleId}
UPDATE SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE SET CURRENT_VERSION = #{currentVersion}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = #{transformRuleId}
